components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they are preferred. On a response this is the
            composed, normalized address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned
            when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a
            household); the owner is then created as a declared household member
            rather than rejected as a household duplicate, and is not flagged as
            a possible duplicate. Write-only; never returned in responses.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                names.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as 'title lastName' when a title
                is present (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the lastName when no title
                was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped
                in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is
                a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same
                last name and postcode). Computed deterministically as the first
                12 hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalized last name + '|' +
                postcode), so owners in the same household share the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same first name and last name, compared
                case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year's starting calendar year. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to that calendar
                year's fiscal year and one before 1 July belongs to the previous
                calendar year's fiscal year. Absent when no registrationDate is
                available.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (see
                'fiscalYear') derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3
                for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year, measured as the
                number of fiscal-year starts (1 July) between the
                registrationDate and the current date.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 5
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city
                using the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the locality is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (same last name and postcode, different telephone). Absent
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone + | + (email or empty) + | + householdId'.
                This single key consolidates all duplicate detection: a new owner
                is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey exactly
                matches an existing owner's.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            checkDigit:

I implemented the `capacityWarning` feature so that a newly created owner is flagged when its city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard limit of 50). The hard rejection at 50 (409 conflict) is unchanged.

Changes made:

1. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — in `addOwner`, computed the city's existing owner count once, kept the existing `>= 50` rejection, and set a `capacityWarning` flag true when the count is `>= 40` (the new `CITY_CAPACITY_WARNING_THRESHOLD` constant). 2. **`Owner.java`** — added the `capacityWarning` field (mapped to a `capacity_warning` column) with getter/setter.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `capacityWarning` boolean to the owner DTO schema (which generates `OwnerDto`; MapStruct auto-maps it by name).

4. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `capacity_warning BOOLEAN` column so the flag round-trips through persistence (the tests use the hsqldb + spring-data-jpa profile, which reads the fresh owner back via GET).

The target test `Cp54Tests` (fills a city to 40, then asserts the 41st owner has `capacityWarning: true`) passes, as does `Cp18Tests` (capacity rejection at 50) and the full 66-test suite.
